name: Sawhorse Clamp
tagline: Turn any pair of 2×4s into a sawhorse in ten seconds — no hardware, no fuss.
description:
The Sawhorse Clamp is a single printed part that grips a 2×4 on edge and holds a second 2×4 flat across it at a locked 90°. Two of them and a couple of offcuts give you a rock-solid work surface anywhere — the truck bed, the driveway, a friend's garage — then they drop in a tool bag when you're done.

Designed around common filament (PETG or PLA+ both work), printable on a 220×220 bed with no supports. The parametric STEP file lets you resize the jaw for 2×6 or metric timber.

You get the print files, a one-page assembly guide, and the editable CAD source. Print as many as you want for your own shop.
